meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: Claude 能检索跨会话的记忆库,按「搜索 → 时间线 → 取详情」三步找回以前会话里的工作:先给带 ID 的结果列表,再看某条前后的上下文,最后只取你挑中的完整记录。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话而不是当前对话时触发,例如「这个我们修过吗」「上次是怎么解决的」。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里跟 authentication 相关的记录
say.note: 会返回带 ID 的索引列表

say.text: 上次是怎么修 token 过期的?给我看那条前后的上下文
say.note: 调 timeline 展示锚点前后条目

say.text: 把 ID #11131 和 #10942 的完整内容取出来
say.note: 一次批量取回多条完整观测

howto.what_en: Claude gains a search tool over claude-mem's cross-session database. It runs a three-step flow: search for an ID index, view timeline context around a hit, then fetch full observations only for the IDs you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?"

say_en.text: How did we fix token expiration last time? Show its timeline
Fetch full details for IDs 11131 and 10942
